Old source uses frozen C4 head or its source L_s prototype-weighted prior; both use frozen C4/C8 R42 kernel rule with residual strength 1 and source-fixed ridge; unsupported old/new target gate removed.
Old class kernel-residual columns share one value, preserving frozen-prior old class ordering.
Original physical split excludes old support from its query for paired comparison; physical examples may be query at another K.
All target observations are previously exposed evaluation: no blind test claim or target-result tuning.
Native existing S0Q0 reused; other new-path versus native S0Q0 is cross-input, not matched.
Each existing prediction unit is reused from r01; predecessor workers finish naturally and count against GPU caps.
CPU states share a mathematically identical kernel; support size >=256 uses FP64 CUDA with pair budget 262144 and CPU fallback for close ties.
Four actual-checkpoint source-only smoke checks compare scores and predictions before controller handoff; no target or query access.
All 84 units and 10752 predictions freeze globally before independent four-process CPU truth-last scoring.
